MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The microSD card with an adapter fits my repeated purchases of memory cards and a card reader; it offers storage I could use with compatible equipment.",
    "The longer HDMI cable fits my pattern of buying practical connection accessories, while the compact flash drive fits my recurring need for removable storage, although its USB 2.0 speed makes it less attractive for large transfers."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart speakers and streaming devices add activities I have not shown a current need for; owning a television or tablet does not mean I want voice control or another streaming option.",
    "The older Fire tablet offers little reason to replace the newer Fire 7 in my history, and 4K streaming capability has limited appeal for my recorded 720p television.",
    "The earbuds could be useful in general, but they do not connect to the camera, storage, and connection needs reflected in my purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, even though my related purchases were storage and accessories for that tablet.",
    "The suggestions lean too heavily on general electronics appeal; sharing a broad connection to my devices matters less than helping me use the equipment I already have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy specific supporting items such as cables, mounts, memory-card holders, and power accessories, which suggests practical equipment needs rather than a desire for more standalone devices.",
    "My latest lens-cap purchase and repeated tripod purchases make camera accessories relevant, provided their fit with my equipment can be established.",
    "Compatibility and a useful improvement matter: a memory card needs to work with my devices, a cable needs the right connection and length, and a replacement device needs a clear advantage over what I already own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my need for storage and connections but stretched my device purchases into unsupported interest in smart speakers, streaming equipment, and an older tablet."
}
